shared_elements: animal figure in profile rendered in low relief
stacked/vertically layered arrangement of figures on one face
rough rubble and stone debris surrounding the carved block
justification: Both show pale limestone blocks carved with profile animal figures set among rubble, and both stack motifs one above another on a single face, which is the clearest correspondence. However, A is dominated by bold, almost fully three-dimensional rounded high relief on a narrow vertical pillar, while B is a broad flat slab covered with shallow, schematic, linear relief organised into horizontal registers of arcs, hatching, birds and a disc — a quite different manner and composition.
